Very, very fun remaster of the original Risk of Rain (2013):tm:

Along with the more detailed graphics, the game also gives quite a bit of customization with how you want your runs to go. Artifacts, increasing/decreasing damage taken/given, whether to enable certain mechanics in the game, it's very nice.
The new additions to the roster is also great. Artificer, Pilot, and Drifter being the new survivors to play around with. [spoiler] and also the super secret one ooooooh so secret [/spoiler]

also yes the music is good
the base game is a addictive , and my autistic ass has been obsessed with it . and if you decide to MOD IT , and get STARTSTORM , ggs dude , you ain't ever stopping

This game is one of my hyperfixations. I love it, in spite of the hordes of magma worms. I enjoy sinking hours into it, building my skill level, learning which items are best to get and in which order, and learning how to use the survivors to the fullest. In spite of the magma worms. One of my favourite survivors is acrid, who is a big mutated acidic lizard who looks like he'd either really enjoy belly rubs or rip me limb from limb. I enjoy playing as him in spite of the fact that he struggles to deal with the magma worms and most of my runs with him die to magma worms. He is the goodest boi. I need to go outside and touch grass, where there are no magma worms, but instead I stay here and keep playing. Despite the magma worms...

One of the greatest, if not, THE GREATEST indie game of all time. 

This definitive release is the only good Risk of Rain game left to play and a permanent installation on any computer. Somehow Gearbox didn't ruin this release despite taking a massive dump on Risk of Rain 2 after they acquired the IP.

We never got more than 60fps on this one despite them saying they were working on it after launch. But 60fps locked is the Gold standard, and it does so flawlessly. 

The definitive Risk of Rain experience. Highly recommend.
